lab.title: The Missing Crystals
lab.intro: Four boxes of Nexus crystals were left in the hall, 12 crystals in each box. This morning, one box was empty and some crystals have vanished. Time to investigate, detective!

clues.name: The empty box
clues.text: The empty box has a sticky blue smear on the lid.

clues.name: A note
clues.text: A note on the shelf says: 'The crystals vanished right after the 2 o'clock bell.'

clues.name: The art room door
clues.text: The art room door handle has fresh blue ink on it. It is the only blue ink in the hall.

clues.name: The count
clues.text: The other boxes are full. Only 45 crystals can be found in all.

steps.q: Which clues point to the art room?
choices: The blue smear and the blue ink on the door

steps.q: Who could NOT have taken the crystals after the 2 o'clock bell?
choices: Students who were in math class then
A student in the art room

steps.q: There should be 4 boxes of 12 crystals, but only 45 are found. How many are missing?

lab.title: The Silent Bell
lab.intro: The school bell used to ring every 45 minutes, starting at 8:00. Today it rings so quietly that nobody can hear it. Someone must have tampered with it.

clues.name: Inside the bell
clues.text: A wad of white cotton fluff is stuffed inside the bell.

clues.name: The schedule
clues.text: The bell rings every 45 minutes: 8:00, 8:45, 9:30 and so on.

clues.name: The fluff
clues.text: The fluff is the same as the cotton in the janitor's cleaning rags.

clues.name: The closet
clues.text: The rag closet door was left open a crack.

steps.q: Why is the bell so quiet?
The bell rings at 8:00, 8:45 and 9:30. When does it ring next?
Where does the trail of clues end?

chronicle.title: The Academy's First Days
chronicle.intro: Hidden around the Nexus are old stories about the academy. Solve each question to unlock the next piece of the Chronicle.

steps.lore: Long ago, the academy was only a plan on paper. A school needs more than a plan, though. It began the day the very first doors opened.
steps.q: When did the academy truly begin?

steps.lore: Above the entrance, the founders hung an emblem. It glowed softly, because it was made of light that crystals had stored up.
steps.q: What was the emblem made of?

steps.lore: The First Keeper never walked alone. Two gray wolves guarded the gates day and night.
The academy had 7 great doors, and every door had 3 locks. Each lock needed a different kind of key: knowledge, kindness or courage.
steps.q: How many locks were there in all?

steps.lore: At last the Keeper wrote the academy's oldest rule on the wall for every hero to read.
